title: ACT IX
subtitle: The Frozen Expanse
rewardRelicDesc: All your units gain +2 max HP and your base gains +8 max HP at the start of every battle.

intro.title: THE FROZEN EXPANSE
intro.text:
The ley lines don't slow down in the cold. They run straight through the ice, bright orange against the white, like cracks in a frozen river that's trying to remember it used to flow.

The Frozen Expanse has been like this since before the Fracture. The Fracture just made it larger. Colder. More hostile to visitors.

The Pale Engine is in there. It has been there for a long time. It is not pleased to have directions.

intro.title: THE PALE ENGINE
intro.text:
Nobody built the Pale Engine — or if they did, they did it so long ago that the Engine has stopped caring about the distinction. It runs on cold and purpose. Its purpose is to hold the Expanse against everything that isn't ice.

It doesn't sleep. It doesn't negotiate. It processes.

You represent an input it hasn't encountered before. It is in the process of developing a protocol.

intro.title: INTO THE WHITE
intro.text:
The cold here isn't just weather. It's structural. It holds the landscape together in a way that makes you understand why the Pale Engine defends it — remove the cold and the whole Expanse would need to rethink what it is.

You aren't here to take the cold. You're here to pass through it.

The Pale Engine will need to understand that distinction. You will need to explain it forcefully.

outro.title: THE PALE ENGINE HALTS
outro.text:
The Pale Engine doesn't fall. It stops — a precise, deliberate cessation, like a machine completing a cycle rather than failing. The cold continues around it. The Expanse doesn't care who won.

The ley lines pulse through the ice and keep going. They were never going to stop for this.

outro.title: WHAT IT PROCESSED
outro.text:
At some point during the battle, the Engine processed the situation correctly: you were not there to hold the Expanse, you were there to cross it.

It had not previously computed that as an option worth defending against.

This is, apparently, an update to its protocol.

outro.title: THE FROST MANTLE
outro.text:
The Frost Mantle is a layer of something that was once the Engine's outer casing — dense, cold, and almost ornamental in the way it's settled into a shape that fits across your shoulders.

The cold doesn't bother you as much as it did. That's the point.

The ley lines run on. The Expanse recedes behind you.

glacier-gate.description: The frozen threshold of the Expanse. Crawlers patrol the ice shelf.

frost-shrine.label: Frost Shrine
frost-shrine.description: A column of ice with something preserved at the centre. The cold here is specific.

eventConfig.description: A pillar of ancient ice, perfectly clear. Something is frozen at the centre — hard to identify, but clearly significant. The cold radiates outward in a way that feels intentional.

cold-trader.label: Cold Cache
cold-trader.description: A trader who operates out of a buried depot. Everything is kept cold. That's not optional.

ice-crossing.label: Ice Crossing
ice-crossing.description: A frozen ford. The ice holds. The Engine's regulars do not.

blizzard-battery.label: Blizzard Battery
blizzard-battery.description: Ice artillery emplacements dug into the glacier face.

glacier-vent.label: Glacier Vent
glacier-vent.description: A fissure where compressed air vents through the ice. Things get caught in it.

pale-elite.label: Pale Guard
pale-elite.description: The Engine's elite frost constructs. Specifically calibrated against intrusion.

engine-approach.label: Engine Approach
engine-approach.description: The final approach. The glacier here is machine-carved. Precise.

engine-log.label: Engine Archive
engine-log.description: A cold-storage data post. The Pale Engine records everything.

eventConfig.description: An access node to the Pale Engine's memory lattice — a crystalline storage of everything it has processed since the Fracture. Its record of the event is purely numerical. That's oddly clarifying.

deep-freeze.label: Thermal Pocket
deep-freeze.description: A geothermal vent keeps one small chamber above freezing. It feels like luxury.

engine-vanguard.label: Engine Vanguard
engine-vanguard.description: The Pale Engine's direct extensions. Each unit is a direct line to its processing core.

paleengine.label: The Pale Engine
paleengine.description: Cold-logic fortress intelligence. It holds the Expanse. It has always held the Expanse.
bossDialogue: Intrusion logged. Threat assessment: non-zero. Protocol: engage.
You are not cold enough to belong here. That is a correctable condition.
The Expanse has stood since before your records. It will stand after.

node-1776873511309.label: Outer Ice Shelf
node-1776873511309.description: Wind-scoured ice stretches outward. Movement here does not go unnoticed.

node-1776873512682.label: Fractured Glacier Face
node-1776873512682.description: Cracked sheets of ice shift under pressure. Something moves beneath them.

node-1776873630290.label: Collapsed Ice Run
node-1776873630290.description: A partially broken route where the glacier has given way to hidden depths. And then you see them — bears made of ice, stalking the hollowed-out channel.

node-1776873634845.label: Wind-Carved Traverse
node-1776873634845.description: Sharp ice ridges shaped by relentless wind. Visibility comes and goes.

node-1776873646236.label: Cryo Sentinels
node-1776873646236.description: Advanced frost constructs, tuned to respond instantly to foreign movement.

node-1776873661402.label: Frozen Channel
node-1776873661402.description: A narrow passage of solid ice. The surface is stable, but echoes travel far.
